editorial.blurb: First Sip Cafe is a whimsical, beautifully curated tea and coffee destination where creative Vietnamese-inspired drinks meet genuine hospitality and a thoughtfully decorated space that feels both bohemian and welcoming.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during quieter hours to fully enjoy the seating and service—reviewers note the cafe gets hectic during peak times. Ask the baristas for recommendations and don't hesitate to request adjustments like double-length steeps or custom sugar levels.
